title: Business School
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael guest lectures in Ryan's class, sharing his views on business and inspiring students. The episode features humorous incidents involving a bat in the office, Pam showcasing her artwork, and office banter about culture and leadership. Michael's interactions highlight his desire to motivate and connect with others, despite the episode's humorous chaos.
